column1: # Distal design WITH steppe pastoralist sources (opt-in variant of config/pop_pools_distal.tsv).
# Why: the plain distal pool has only EEHG as an EHG-related source. Bronze Age steppe groups (Yamnaya, Srubnaya/Sintashta/Corded Ware) are
# EEHG + Caucasus/Iran-related ancestry (Steppe_EMBA) or those plus Anatolian farmer ancestry (Steppe_MLBA), so modern Iranians with a
# 'steppe' signal could take it from a steppe source instead of EEHG. Here the steppe groups are ADDED to the rotated pool and the data choose.
#   Steppe_MLBA = Western_Steppe_MLBA (n=46) + Srubnaya (n=2, Mathieson 2015; ADMIXTURE profile identical to Western_Steppe_MLBA)
# CAVEATS: (1) these are NOT pre-Copper-Age, so this is a mixed-depth (distal + proximal) model; read it as 'is the EEHG-like share better
#   carried by a steppe population?'. (2) Steppe_MLBA is itself a mixture of EEHG, Iran_N-like and Anatolia_N, so it is nearly collinear with
#   combinations of other pool members; the qpWave source screen drops sets that are not independent and the rotation puts un-chosen steppe
#   groups on the RIGHT, which can reject models (a steppe-rich right set vs EEHG left). Compare with the plain distal run, never merge them.
#   (3) Srubnaya alone has n=2, so it is pooled into Steppe_MLBA instead of being its own source.
